snippet.title: The Scourge (Tai Ương) - Official Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Get another look at The Scourge in this terrifying trailer for the 3D atmospheric horror adventure rooted in Vietnamese urban legend and supernatural folklore. Set against the gritty backdrop of 1990s Saigon, it brings cultural memory, personal trauma, and malevolent supernatural forces into collision. The Scourge is available now on PC (via Steam and Epic Games Store). It is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S.

#IGN #Gaming
